newsitem.title: USA: G7 hails Russia action on IMF loan - Russia finmin.
newsitem.headline: G7 hails Russia action on IMF loan - Russia finmin.

text.p: Russian Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said on Saturday that G7 central bankers and finance minister had viewed positively Russia's fulfillment of its $10 billion IMF loan program.

Asked about Russia's prospects of receiving the latest tranche under the three-year loan, Livshits said, "Practically, the evaluation was positive of what we are doing to fulfill the EFF (Extended Fund Facility) program."
He said the G7 had supported Russia's efforts to stabilize state finances and that the Russian side described what measures it was adopting.
The G7 had shown great interest in Russia's planned new tax system.
"In other words, we saw no divergence between the policy we are following and the positions of the finance ministers and central bank chairmen," Livshits said.
